component.name: Shadhin Browser
component.summary: Fast, private, and open native Linux web browser

description.p: Shadhin Browser (স্বাধীন ব্রাউজার; "Shadhin" means free/independent) is a high-performance, privacy-respecting native Linux browser engineered with Rust, GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0.

ul.li: Native Wayland and X11 rendering via GTK4 and Libadwaita
Hardware-accelerated WebKitGTK 6.0 engine with process isolation
Native tracker and ad-blocking using WebKitUserContentFilterStore
Customizable workspaces and glassmorphic UI matching modern GNOME aesthetics
Strict telemetry-free architecture and verified privacy metrics
Native GTK4 and Libadwaita dark glassmorphism user interface.
Real WebKitGTK 6.0 multi-process web browsing engine.
Native content filtering (EasyList and EasyPrivacy rules).
Bookmark management with Netscape HTML and JSON import/export.
Isolated workspaces and session crash recovery.
Verified file permissions and zero-telemetry architecture.
